FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 350
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Senator Donnie Chesteen
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/13/2026
Senate Bill 350 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the State Health
Planning and Development Agency by a small undetermined amount to: (1) issue and renew
certificates to entities that are engaging in activities that carry out the state's policy provided in
this bill; and (2) adopt rules that provide for the ongoing and active supervision of certified
entities.
